correctness.rationale: Character orthogonality yields Q_{p,z}(f_c)=sqrt(2)c_S and exactly uniform independent slopes S for nonzero prime generators. A positive median of height v forces at least q distinct coefficients >=v; Cauchy norm gives v<=1/sqrt(q), matched by setting the q most occupied coefficients equal. Multinomial law and disjoint majority-class binomial tail are exact; top d=s/2 occupancies always cover a majority and strong law gives eventual q=d. Binomial large deviations on (d-1)-subsets provide -1/2 log(1-4/s^2). For a fixed half-class Fourier function the Bernoulli median event is exactly 1/2. Small sample occupancy enumeration corroborates rather than proves the asymptotic statements.
